ECE 685 | Power Systems Design L25
Line Parameters IV
Calculate one verified R-X-B record from conductor and
tower data
Buxin She
Mike Wiegers Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

Lecture outline
Prepare the geometry once, calculate the phase parameters, and assemble one
complete 𝑅, 𝑋, 𝐵 record per physical circuit.
1 Geometry: identify circuits and bundles; calculate phase GMD and both bundle
self-distances.
2 Parameters: calculate resistance, inductance, and capacitance rates; obtain 𝑋′
and 𝐵′ at frequency 𝑓 .
3 Route record: form physical totals, charging quantities, and per-unit values.
4 Exercises: follow the same geometry-to-parameters sequence and verify the
record.
Textbook: Glover, Overbye, and Sarma, Power System Analysis and Design , 6th ed. (2017).
Sections 4.4, 4.6, 4.10, and 4.13. Detailed references are retained in the instructor notes.
